subject: 明代北方小民居，7×6格，青灰砖硬山灰瓦（原创扩展；细部待考）
prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: tianshu default building-map, ONE isolated reusable game building cutout, true RGBA transparent background. Image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its realistic historical painted material quality, crisp detailed grey roof tiles, believable aged masonry and wood, natural muted colors and detail density. Do not copy its building or old camera inaccuracies. This is a new Ming-era northern Chinese prefectural-town building, original game design, NOT restoration of a named monument. Camera MUST be orthographic dimetric 2:1 ground projection, yaw 45 degrees elevation 30 degrees: ground edges exact +0.5 and -0.5 slopes, all verticals upright, no vanishing point. Main frontage faces screen lower left. Ground footprint must be a thin flat rectangular apron with clearly visible straight left-to-front and front-to-right edges, front base corner visible, no thick pedestal or surrounding street. Entire eaves, ground edge and short shadow fully inside square frame with 10 percent transparent margins. Sunlight screen upper left, short soft contact shadow screen lower right. Northern Ming hard-gable YINGSHAN roof: restrained straight ridge, grey clay pantiles, solid masonry gable ends, grey brick and warm-grey plaster walls, subdued dark timber lattice doors/windows; no Qing imperial decoration. No written characters, signboards, lettering, symbols, people, background scenery, sky, horizon, mountains, labels, watermark, checkerboard, opaque floor, exaggerated curved eaves, cartoon or toy-like stylization. Generate exactly ONE asset. Subject: SMALL ordinary northern Chinese home, footprint width 7m along left-front visible edge by depth 6m along front-right visible edge. One modest single-storey three-bay residence with one central wood door, small lattice windows, no courtyard, no separate annex. ALL walls unplastered dark warm-grey exposed masonry brick, not white or cream. The gable wall reaches flush up to the roof edges (true hard-gable yingshan) without overhanging verge rafters. No transverse exposed horizontal timber bands in side wall. Grey unglazed concave-and-convex modest flat clay roof tiles. The structure is visibly DIFFERENT from the southern white plaster reference. Wooden doors and lattice windows dark brown. One plain clay storage jar beside doorway. The thin floor perimeter MUST fit a parallelogram: from left ground corner to front corner screen delta (7,+3.5), front to right delta(6,-3). Ground corner lines visible and clean. CRITICAL: exposed grey brick walls, plain restrained northern architecture, no white plaster. Correct base diamond geometry: left-to-front base vector (7,3.5) and front-to-right (6,-3), exact 1:2 vertical/horizontal slopes. Only low shallow brick ridge ends, no decorative curled horn ridges.
